name: Open Support Tickets
query:
SELECT
	`tabSupport Ticket`.name AS `Ticket:Link/Support Ticket:160`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.subject AS `Subject:Data:200`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.customer AS `Customer:Link/Customer:140`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.status AS `Status:Data:120`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.priority AS `Priority:Data:80`,
	`tabSupport Ticket`.opening_date AS `Opening Date:Datetime:160`
FROM `tabSupport Ticket`
WHERE `tabSupport Ticket`.status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY `tabSupport Ticket`.opening_date DESC
LIMIT 500
